summary.name: Penelope AI
summary.one_liner: Penelope AI is an AI-assisted writing editor that helps draft, rewrite, paraphrase, summarize and retrieve information from PDFs.
use_cases: change the tone of a document
pull information out of pdf files
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI-powered editor where autocomplete anticipates and composes text when the user types ++ or opens a menu with /. It can rewrite and change the tone of a document, including reducing repeated words. It can condense lengthy documents into concise summaries highlighting key points. It is also described as able to retrieve information from PDFs and offers interactive video chats and automated content generation. The page lists Free, Ace and Team pricing plans.
notable: Slash menu and ++ autocomplete that composes text from context
Summarizes lengthy documents into key points
caveats: Free plan limited to 50 AI credits and 10 file uploads
Paid Ace plan listed at 140/year; Team plan has no price shown
Refund available only if requested within 14 days of purchase
